CalloutConfig.DispatchText: Someone got hurt playing sport and needs help.
CalloutConfig.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A player is injured at a sports field nearby. Please respond.
CalloutConfig.EnRouteHelpText: Drive to the yellow marker, then get out and walk up to the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneText: You're on scene. Check on the player.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneVoiceLine: On scene. Checking on the player now.
CalloutConfig.AssessmentHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to help the player.
CalloutConfig.ConversationHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to talk to the player.
CalloutConfig.TreatingText: Checking the injury and helping the player...
CalloutConfig.ResolutionVoiceLine: Nice work. The player is going to be just fine.

Injury.DispatchText: A player got a knock and has a sore, bruised knee.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A player has a bruised knee at the field nearby. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Player
DialogueLine.Text: I got a knock on the knee, it's a bit sore.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Let me put an ice pack on it - you'll be fine.

Injury.TreatingText: Putting an ice pack on the knee...
Injury.TreatedText: All better! Just a bruise - iced and good to go.

Injury.DispatchText: A player sprained their wrist and needs it wrapped.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A player sprained their wrist at the field nearby. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Player
DialogueLine.Text: I fell on my wrist, it's hard to move it.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Let's wrap that wrist up nice and snug.

Injury.TreatedText: Nice work - wrist wrapped and the player feels much better.

Injury.DispatchText: A player may have broken their arm - needs the hospital.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A player may have a broken arm at the field nearby. Please respond quickly.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Player
DialogueLine.Text: My arm really hurts, I think it might be broken.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Hold still, I'll support it - we'll get you to the hospital for an x-ray.

Injury.TransportedText: Great job! The player is taken to the hospital to check the arm.
